Representing the late canonical genre of verses recounting the past devotional deeds and resulting karmic fruitions of an elder (*thera*), the poem is catalogued on SuttaCentral with translations recorded in five modern languages, though it lacks an English title in that database [SuttaCentral].

No cross-language parallels in Chinese, Sanskrit, or Tibetan collections are reported by SuttaCentral or identified by DharmaNexus [SuttaCentral; DharmaNexus].
